name: laravel-nova-agents
description: The laravel-nova subagent for building Laravel Nova admin panels — BaseResource abstract class, custom Fields, Actions, Lenses, Filters, Metrics, CSV/Excel export, and Laravel Dusk browser tests — plus the companion wame-nova-patterns skill holding the Nova reference material and Dusk testing patterns. Install alongside laravel-agents: the pest-tester agent conditionally invokes wame-nova-patterns for Nova/Dusk browser testing only when this plugin is present, so non-Nova projects stay clean.
